how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Kokrajhar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website:https://kokrajhar.dcourts.gov.in/ .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Kokrajhar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:https://kokrajhar.dcourts.gov.in/ . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Kokrajhar Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Para Legal Volunteer posts is 15th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Para Legal Volunteer position is 18 years. Candidates must meet this age criterion to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least Matriculation to be eligible for the Para Legal Volunteer post. This is the basic educational requirement for the role.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies available for the Para Legal Volunteer post in the District Legal Services Authority Kokrajhar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DLSA Kokrajhar Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Para Legal Volunteer posts in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer posts includes shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Who are eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates include citizens of India and local residents of Kokrajhar District who have passed Matriculation and belong to specified groups like teachers, retired government servants, law students, etc.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed term as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be found on the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Kokrajhar or through the links provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
